name: Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (MTBS)
description: U.S.-wide wildfire and prescribed-fire perimeter and burn-severity mapping program; provides fire-level and aggregated perimeter products for large fires from 1984 onward.
citation: Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (MTBS). Interagency program for mapping burn severity and fire extent across U.S. lands.
